Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: exec sponsor update & SLA exception triage

Hi Lori / Novamed team,

Quick MAP check-in ahead of our Friday close call. Two fast items: an SLA exception flagged during last night's evaluation run, and the updated owner roll-up for the mutual action plan. Please see the attachments (MAP_master_v4.xlsx + support logs).

Status highlights:
- MAP milestones: evaluation run #3 completed (model latency spike during batch replay).
- SLA exception: elevated 503/timeout rate for inference on the dedicated pool between 02:30-03:45 UTC; estimated impact ~5% of evaluation traffic.
- Close timeline: customer evaluation & procurement target still 2026-06-10 pending sign-off from executive sponsor.

Immediate asks:
1) Executive sponsor confirmation: can Ellen Park approve temporary priority support and capacity burst if we need to reprovision GPU capacity? (This would shorten rollback window.)
2) Approve shared log access for our infra team (we've attached a zip of logs + screenshots).

Action items (owners):
- A1: Triage root cause and confirm whether KV cache invalidation created an outage pattern — owner: Rishi Malhotra — ETA: 2026-05-19 EOD.
- A2: Prepare a scoped SLA exception request for executive approval (includes cost/impact) — owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2026-05-20 12:00 PDT.
- A3: Update MAP milestones sheet with sponsor sign-off column — owner: Jonas Weber — ETA: 2026-05-19 11:00 PDT.

I can jump on a short bridge if helpful; we plan a deeper post-mortem on Wed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Neha / team —

Quick technical update from infra: preliminary signal points at the KV-cache layer (interaction between sequence-preserving batching and an edge-case tokenization pattern) — not an immediate hardware fault.

What this means:
- Mitigation 1 (fast): flip to conservative batching for the evaluation pool + force KV cache flush on staging traffic. Low risk, should reduce error rate within 30–60m.
- Mitigation 2 (if errors persist): schedule a targeted capacity burst and reprovision a hot node to isolate the bad corrupt state. Estimated incremental cost for a 12-hr burst (p3-equivalent) ~ $1.8k — ballpark.

I opened priority support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7890 — includes logs and repro steps. Assigning to A1 owner (me) to run the flush and monitor.

I'll post a short runbook once flush completes.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Please confirm whether Novamed will approve the burst from evaluation credits or whether we should continue with mitigation-only. If you prefer, we can ask finance to pre-approve up to $2.5k for emergency capacity.
